coding_practice.title: N-Repeated Element in Size 2N Array
coding_practice.description:
You are given an integer array nums with the following properties:

nums.length == 2 * n.
nums contains n + 1 unique elements.
Exactly one element of nums is repeated n times.
Return the element that is repeated n times.
coding_practice.constraints:
2 <= n <= 5000
nums.length == 2 * n
0 <= nums[i] <= 10^4
nums contains n + 1 unique elements and one of them is repeated exactly n times.
coding_practice.explanation:
1. 定義自訂例外 InvalidInputError，用於處理輸入不符合規範的情況。
2. 計算 n = len(nums)//2，並檢查 nums 是否符合長度和唯一元素數量的規範，若不符合則 raise 錯誤。
3. 使用 set 記錄已經遇過的元素，一旦再次出現即為重複 n 次的元素，回傳該元素。
4. 理論上題目保證一定有解，如果找不到則 raise 例外以防意外。
